subject.title: Allow multiple account in the status bar for same provider.

question: Should CodexBar proceed with the selected-account status-item mode described in the multi-account design, including aggregate-item replacement, a four-account cap, aliases/ordinals, and mutual exclusion with Merge Icons?
rationale: Current main has the account-snapshot and stacked-menu foundation but no account identity, persistence, ordering, or coexistence contract for status items; the owner explicitly left these product choices for discussion.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded selected-account mode
options.body: Adopt the documented opt-in, capped account-item mode that replaces the provider aggregate item and is mutually exclusive with Merge Icons.

options.title: Retain menu-only account visibility
options.body: Keep the current stacked account cards and defer status-bar fan-out until a stronger user need or interaction model is established.

options.title: Choose an additive account-item design
options.body: Allow selected account items alongside the provider aggregate only after explicitly defining duplication, merge-mode, ordering, and migration behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded selected-account mode
recommendation.body: Adopt the documented opt-in, capped account-item mode that replaces the provider aggregate item and is mutually exclusive with Merge Icons.

likelyOwner.reason: The owner authored both the architecture decision and the issue comments that frame the remaining product choices.
